messages:
Alex: Heads-up — vendor just notified us that the SWA allocation for the March window is being reduced by ~20%. They cited a late batch DOA and customs backlog. Need plan for top-up or replacement units.
Maya: Ugh. Which serials are affected? Can we swap from the EWR pool? :thinking_face:
Alex: They sent a CSV of serials. Most affected are S/N range 22k-23k (A800s). EWR only has 6 units available, not enough.
Sam: If we pull from EWR, cross-region transfer adds ~48h and customs clearance costs. Rough delta = +$1.2k/unit (brokerage + expedited freight).
Dina: Any chance vendor can expedite replacements under warranty? What's their RMA ETA?
Alex: Vendor RMA ETA = 7–10 business days for replacements. They offered temporary loaners for 30 days but at a daily lease rate.
Luis: Can we accept loaners? Cost math: loaner = $50/day/unit => ~ $1.5k for 30 days per unit vs $1.2k crossship. Loaners cheaper if we need < 25 units.
Maya: We need 42 units to hit committed capacity for the quarter. Loaners won't cover full deficit.
Sam: Two levers: 1) pay freight to re-route EWR -> SWA and cover customs, 2) accept mixed loaner + crossship. Also check whether Dedicated SLAs require us to notify customers.
Dina: Please sanity-check insurance: vendor is pushing declared value lower than our PO. If claim occurs during crossship, underwriting will deny partial claim. Need written confirmation of insured value = PO amount.
Alex: Agreed. I requested vendor confirmation on insured value and AWB-level coverage. Waiting on reply.
LogisticsBot: AWB created: 772-998-3345. Status: in transit to EWR consolidation hub. ETA EWR 2026-03-29 18:00 UTC.
Maya: If we re-route from that AWB, can forwarder divert pickup to SWA consolidation to cut transit time?
LogisticsBot: Forwarder allowlist check: diversion allowed but surcharge applies. Estimated surcharge = $950 per AWB.
Sam: Quick calc: divert + customs = $950 + $1.2k/unit? Wait those earlier numbers were per unit for full re-route. Need per-AWB vs per-unit breakdown.
Luis: I'll ask ops for per-AWB cost. Also ask vendor for partial credit on brokerage since DOA caused the chain.
Dina: On RMA logistics, if we accept vendor loaners we need a return SOP: label format, temporary serial mapping, and a deposit hold on our end. Who owns the transport once loaner is accepted?
Alex: Vendor covers return freight for loaners within 30 days but wants carrier of choice. They require proof-of-delivery scan + manifest. We'll need to map temporary serials in our provisioning DB.
Maya: Implementation note: provisioning team can map loaner_serial -> customer_node for 2-4 hours of work per 10 units. Ops bandwidth this week = low.
Sam: Alternate: raise a short-term spot purchase on the marketplace to cover 15 units — faster but ~25% higher unit price. That plus 27 units via loaner + 6 crossship would meet 48 total.
Luis: Marketplace spot price premium = $4k/unit extra on top of our negotiated rate. If we buy 15 units, incremental budget impact = ~ $60k.
Alex: Budget impact OK for now, but need approvals from finance for above-threshold spend. Maya — can you ping finance?
Maya: On it. FYI finance flagged that end-of-quarter overages need exec sign-off if >$50k.
Dina: We also need to resolve serial mismatches on returned DOA units before issuing RMA credits. Vendor wants manifest-level photos for each DOA. Ops can provide but turnaround ~48h.
Sam: To keep customers happy, let's propose: 1) Pull 6 from EWR, pay diversion surcharge to get 12 units quickly (two AWBs), 2) take 27 loaners, 3) spot-purchase 15 units. This meets immediate capacity and spreads cost.
Alex: Sounds pragmatic. Action items: Maya -> finance approval for spot buy; Luis -> negotiate broker/insurance credit with vendor; Dina -> ops to prep DOA photos + temp-serial mapping SOP; Sam -> confirm forwarder diversion feasibility and final per-AWB costs. I'll consolidate into a purchase plan and send to execs.
Maya: Finance looped in — tagging @FinanceOps for approval.
Luis: Vendor responded: "We can increase insured declared value to PO amount but need signed amendment. We'll issue 10 expedited replacements by next Tue; remainder on standard RMA." They also offered a $750 AWB credit on 1diversion if we escalate.
Alex: Good. Can we take that credit and reduce spot buy count? Maybe buy 10 instead of 15.
Sam: If we buy 10, cost delta drops by ~$20k. Still need quick approval.
Dina: Ops confirms they can produce DOA photo manifest within 36h if we prioritize.
LogisticsBot: Update: AWB 772-998-3345 re-route planned. Estimated final ETA to SWA consolidation 2026-03-27 09:00 UTC after diversion. Surcharge estimate locked at $940.
Maya: Final ask to vendors channel — please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to the mixed plan (6 EWR divert + 27 loaners + spot 10). Otherwise reply with alternatives.
Luis: :thumbsup: I'll draft the amendment for insurance + ask for the $750 AWB credit to be applied.
Alex: Thanks team — I'll draft the exec summary now.
Maya: Filing note: will drop PO change request in procurement queue once finance confirms.
